column2: Proper Noun: Name of a specific person, place, or thing
Common Noun: General name of a person, place, or thing
Collective Noun: Name of a group considered as one unit
Abstract Noun: Name of a quality, state, or feeling
Material Noun: Name of a substance or material
Concrete Noun: Noun that can be seen or touched
Countable Noun: Nouns that can be counted in numbers
Uncountable Noun: Nouns that cannot be counted individually
